grammar.summary: 本课学习 must 的否定与时间表达，辨析 mustn't 与 needn't。

points.title: mustn't 禁止 vs needn't 不必
points.explanation: mustn't = 千万不要（禁止）；needn't = 不必（没义务）。You mustn't get up yet.（还不许起床）与 You needn't come.（你不必来）意义完全不同。

points.title: 频率表达
points.explanation: How often...? 问频率，回答 once a day / three times a day。

examples.en: You must take this medicine once a day.
